import math
from App import Vector

body = doc.getObject('Body')
xz = doc.getObject('XZ_Plane')

pad_def = design['features']['pad-outer']
half_length = pad_def['position']['the transverse centre plane']['mm']
radius = pad_def['radius']['mm']
height = design['envelope']['height']['mm']
depth = pad_def['depth']['mm']
bottom_z = pad_def['position']['the bottom face']['mm']
top_z = bottom_z + height

left_cx = -half_length + radius
right_cx = half_length - radius

sk = doc.addObject('Sketcher::SketchObject', 'OuterProfile')
sk.AttachmentSupport = [(xz, '')]
sk.MapMode = 'FlatFace'

sk.addGeometry(Part.LineSegment(Vector(left_cx, bottom_z, 0), Vector(right_cx, bottom_z, 0)), False)
right_circle = Part.Circle(Vector(right_cx, bottom_z+radius, 0), Vector(0,0,1), radius)
sk.addGeometry(Part.ArcOfCircle(right_circle, -math.pi/2, math.pi/2), False)
sk.addGeometry(Part.LineSegment(Vector(right_cx, top_z, 0), Vector(left_cx, top_z, 0)), False)
left_circle = Part.Circle(Vector(left_cx, bottom_z+radius, 0), Vector(0,0,1), radius)
sk.addGeometry(Part.ArcOfCircle(left_circle, math.pi/2, 3*math.pi/2), False)

body.addObject(sk)
doc.recompute()

pad = doc.addObject('PartDesign::Pad', 'BodyPadOuter')
pad.Profile = sk
pad.Length = depth
pad.Reversed = True
body.addObject(pad)
doc.recompute()

print('pad recompute ok:', built_ok(pad))
print('body recompute ok:', built_ok(body))
bb = bbox(body.Shape)
print('body bbox X', bb.XLength, 'Y', bb.YLength, 'Z', bb.ZLength)
print('solids in body shape:', len(body.Shape.Solids))
print('body volume', body.Shape.Volume)

import math
from App import Vector

body = doc.getObject('Body')
xz = doc.getObject('XZ_Plane')

pf = design['features']['pocket-front']
depth = pf['depth']['mm']
angle = pf['angle']['deg']
radius = pf['radius']['mm']
width = pf['width']['mm']

hole_left = design['features']['hole-left']
hole_right = design['features']['hole-right']
left_bore_x = -hole_left['position']['the transverse centre plane']['mm']
right_bore_x = hole_right['position']['the transverse centre plane']['mm']
bore_z = hole_left['position']['the bottom face']['mm']

half_h = width/2.0
top_z = bore_z + half_h
bottom_z = bore_z - half_h
x_off = math.sqrt(radius**2 - half_h**2)
left_tan_x = left_bore_x + x_off
right_tan_x = right_bore_x - x_off

sk = doc.addObject('Sketcher::SketchObject', 'PocketFrontProfile')
sk.AttachmentSupport = [(xz, '')]
sk.MapMode = 'FlatFace'
sk.addGeometry(Part.LineSegment(Vector(left_tan_x, top_z, 0), Vector(right_tan_x, top_z, 0)), False)
circ_r = Part.Circle(Vector(right_bore_x, bore_z, 0), Vector(0,0,1), radius)
sk.addGeometry(Part.ArcOfCircle(circ_r, math.radians(150), math.radians(210)), False)
sk.addGeometry(Part.LineSegment(Vector(right_tan_x, bottom_z, 0), Vector(left_tan_x, bottom_z, 0)), False)
circ_l = Part.Circle(Vector(left_bore_x, bore_z, 0), Vector(0,0,1), radius)
sk.addGeometry(Part.ArcOfCircle(circ_l, math.radians(-30), math.radians(30)), False)
body.addObject(sk)
doc.recompute()

pocket = doc.addObject('PartDesign::Pocket', 'PocketFront')
pocket.Profile = sk
pocket.Type = 'Length'
pocket.Length = depth
pocket.Reversed = False
pocket.TaperAngle = -angle
body.addObject(pocket)
doc.recompute()
print('pocket built ok:', built_ok(pocket))
print('body built ok:', built_ok(body))
print('body volume after:', body.Shape.Volume)
print('solids:', len(body.Shape.Solids))

import math
from App import Vector

body = doc.getObject('Body')
xz = doc.getObject('XZ_Plane')

sf = design['features']['slot-front-2x']
angle_deg = sf['angle']['deg']
slot_depth = sf['depth']['mm']

hole_left = design['features']['hole-left']
hole_right = design['features']['hole-right']
left_bore_x = -hole_left['position']['the transverse centre plane']['mm']
right_bore_x = hole_right['position']['the transverse centre plane']['mm']
bore_z = hole_left['position']['the bottom face']['mm']

radius25 = design['features']['pad-outer']['radius']['mm']
far_reach = radius25 * 2

ang = math.radians(angle_deg)
sin_a = math.sin(ang)
cos_a = math.cos(ang)

# left hook (front): from bore axis, straight down, then 60deg toward -X (left end)
L0 = Vector(left_bore_x, bore_z, 0)
L1 = Vector(left_bore_x, bore_z - far_reach, 0)
L2 = Vector(left_bore_x - far_reach*sin_a, bore_z - far_reach*cos_a, 0)

# right hook (front): mirror about X=0
R0 = Vector(right_bore_x, bore_z, 0)
R1 = Vector(right_bore_x, bore_z - far_reach, 0)
R2 = Vector(right_bore_x + far_reach*sin_a, bore_z - far_reach*cos_a, 0)

sk = doc.addObject('Sketcher::SketchObject', 'SlotFrontProfile')
sk.AttachmentSupport = [(xz, '')]
sk.MapMode = 'FlatFace'

sk.addGeometry(Part.LineSegment(L0, L1), False)
sk.addGeometry(Part.LineSegment(L1, L2), False)
sk.addGeometry(Part.LineSegment(L2, L0), False)

sk.addGeometry(Part.LineSegment(R0, R1), False)
sk.addGeometry(Part.LineSegment(R1, R2), False)
sk.addGeometry(Part.LineSegment(R2, R0), False)

body.addObject(sk)
doc.recompute()

shape = sk.Shape
print('edges', len(shape.Edges))

pocket = doc.addObject('PartDesign::Pocket', 'SlotFrontPocket')
pocket.Profile = sk
pocket.Type = 'Length'
pocket.Length = slot_depth
pocket.Reversed = False
body.addObject(pocket)
doc.recompute()
print('pocket built ok:', built_ok(pocket))
print('body built ok:', built_ok(body))
print('body volume after:', body.Shape.Volume)
print('solids:', len(body.Shape.Solids))

import math
from App import Vector

def minor_arc_angles(centre, P_first, P_second):
    v1 = P_first - centre
    v2 = P_second - centre
    a1 = math.atan2(v1.y, v1.x)
    a2 = math.atan2(v2.y, v2.x)
    sweep = (a2 - a1) % (2*math.pi)
    if sweep <= math.pi:
        return a1, a2
    else:
        return a2, a1

body = doc.getObject('Body')
xy = doc.getObject('XY_Plane')

hole_right = design['features']['hole-right']
right_bore_x = hole_right['position']['the transverse centre plane']['mm']

pad_radius = design['features']['pad-outer']['radius']['mm']
right_end_x = right_bore_x + pad_radius

height = design['envelope']['height']['mm']
top_z = height

fru = design['features']['fillet-right-upper']
radius20 = fru['radius']['mm']
right_end_offset = fru['position']['the right end face']['mm']
rear_offset = fru['position']['the rear face']['mm']

notch_right = design['features']['notch-right']
front_offset = notch_right['position']['the front face']['mm'][0]

total_depth = design['envelope']['depth front to rear']['mm']

arc_centre_x = right_end_x - right_end_offset
arc_centre_depth = total_depth - rear_offset

A = Vector(right_end_x + right_end_offset, front_offset, 0)
B = Vector(arc_centre_x, front_offset, 0)
C = Vector(right_bore_x, arc_centre_depth, 0)
D = Vector(right_end_x + right_end_offset, arc_centre_depth, 0)
centre = Vector(arc_centre_x, arc_centre_depth, 0)

angStart, angEnd = minor_arc_angles(centre, B, C)
print('angStart deg', math.degrees(angStart), 'angEnd deg', math.degrees(angEnd))

sk = doc.addObject('Sketcher::SketchObject', 'NotchRightUpper')
sk.AttachmentSupport = [(xy, '')]
sk.MapMode = 'FlatFace'
sk.AttachmentOffset = App.Placement(Vector(0,0,top_z), App.Rotation())

sk.addGeometry(Part.LineSegment(A, B), False)
circ = Part.Circle(centre, Vector(0,0,1), radius20)
sk.addGeometry(Part.ArcOfCircle(circ, angStart, angEnd), False)
sk.addGeometry(Part.LineSegment(C, D), False)
sk.addGeometry(Part.LineSegment(D, A), False)

body.addObject(sk)
doc.recompute()

shape = sk.Shape
print('edges', len(shape.Edges))
w = Part.Wire(shape.Edges)
print('closed?', w.isClosed())
face = Part.Face(w)
print('face area', face.Area)

import math
from App import Vector

def minor_arc_angles(centre, P_first, P_second):
    v1 = P_first - centre
    v2 = P_second - centre
    a1 = math.atan2(v1.y, v1.x)
    a2 = math.atan2(v2.y, v2.x)
    sweep = (a2 - a1) % (2*math.pi)
    if sweep <= math.pi:
        return a1, a2
    else:
        return a2, a1

body = doc.getObject('Body')
xy = doc.getObject('XY_Plane')

hole_right = design['features']['hole-right']
right_bore_x = hole_right['position']['the transverse centre plane']['mm']

pad_radius = design['features']['pad-outer']['radius']['mm']
right_end_x = right_bore_x + pad_radius

bottom_z = design['features']['pad-outer']['position']['the bottom face']['mm']

frl = design['features']['fillet-right-lower']
radius20 = frl['radius']['mm']
right_end_offset = frl['position']['the right end face']['mm']
front_offset = frl['position']['the front face']['mm']

notch_right = design['features']['notch-right']
rear_bound = notch_right['position']['the rear face']['mm'][1]

arc_centre_x = right_end_x - right_end_offset
arc_centre_depth = front_offset

A = Vector(right_end_x + right_end_offset, rear_bound, 0)
B = Vector(arc_centre_x, rear_bound, 0)
C = Vector(right_bore_x, arc_centre_depth, 0)
D = Vector(right_end_x + right_end_offset, arc_centre_depth, 0)
centre = Vector(arc_centre_x, arc_centre_depth, 0)

angStart, angEnd = minor_arc_angles(centre, B, C)
print('angStart deg', math.degrees(angStart), 'angEnd deg', math.degrees(angEnd))

sk = doc.addObject('Sketcher::SketchObject', 'NotchRightLower')
sk.AttachmentSupport = [(xy, '')]
sk.MapMode = 'FlatFace'
sk.AttachmentOffset = App.Placement(Vector(0,0,bottom_z), App.Rotation())

sk.addGeometry(Part.LineSegment(A, B), False)
circ = Part.Circle(centre, Vector(0,0,1), radius20)
sk.addGeometry(Part.ArcOfCircle(circ, angStart, angEnd), False)
sk.addGeometry(Part.LineSegment(C, D), False)
sk.addGeometry(Part.LineSegment(D, A), False)

body.addObject(sk)
doc.recompute()

shape = sk.Shape
print('edges', len(shape.Edges))
w = Part.Wire(shape.Edges)
print('closed?', w.isClosed())
face = Part.Face(w)
print('face area', face.Area)

left_lower = doc.getObject('NotchLeftLower')
left_face = Part.Face(Part.Wire(left_lower.Shape.Edges))
assert abs(face.Area - left_face.Area) < 1e-6, "right-lower area %.4f does not mirror left-lower area %.4f" % (face.Area, left_face.Area)
print('area matches mirror of NotchLeftLower')
